key_findings: IGC official listing confirms five international MBA/MBA-family programs and two specialized master programs.
Crawler names were normalized into stable programme names while preserving official detail URLs.
Crawler global-language noise was rejected; all seven modeled IGC programme detail snippets state Language English or are listed in the English IGC catalogue.
Shared central documents and APS/visa notes were retained as shared application evidence, while programme-specific academic and work-experience requirements come from detail pages.
known_gaps: Exact application deadline dates are not exposed in available candidate text for six of seven programs; Aeronautical Management has a captured May 31, 2026 deadline.
General 210 ECTS values from shared requirement pages may not apply to every MBA program and are not hard-coded unless detail-page evidence supports them.
Language test score details are only explicitly captured for MBA Global Management in the available evidence; other programs retain English-certificate document requirements without invented scores.
Executive Management has a title-change approval caveat and remains needs_human_review.
